mudRule: A trip gets condition mud when it rained in the last 24h AND the user's unpavedShare of route is > 0; mud values are blended in by that share.
iceRule: `condition` stays 'snow' (types/trip.ts has no ice). Trips add `surfaceDetail: 'ice'` when snow falls below -3 C with 45% chance.
